title: Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.30556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. translated_title: 基于约束的c-表示及其解的条件化信念基分裂方法
translated_abstract: 条件信念基的分裂概念旨在将推理和计算任务局部化到仅包含信念基相关部分的子基中。在各种推理机制中，c-表示（Spohn排序模型的一种特殊形式）已被证明能够提供高质量的推理，且可以通过约束满足问题来方便地加以描述。在本文中，我们引入了条件约束分裂的概念，通过允许子基之间共享条件句来扩展原有的约束分裂。受条件语法分裂的启发，我们识别出了安全条件约束分裂和完全局部化条件约束分裂这两个子类，使我们能够在各子基上局部且独立地求解约束系统。我们还将c-表示的解分裂推广为安全条件c-解分裂，并对它们之间的关系进行了深入分析。
tldr: 本文提出了条件约束分裂的概念及其安全与完全局部化的子类，使c-表示的约束系统能够在各子基上局部且独立地求解，从而将推理和计算任务局部化到信念基的相关部分。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces conditional constraint splittings along with their safe and fully localized subclasses, enabling local and independent solving of constraint systems for c-representations on subbases, thereby localizing reasoning and computation to relevant parts of the belief base.
